name: Nick Galanti
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: A 28-year-old Dante Rivera BJJ middleweight (8-1) and the reigning CFFC middleweight champion, who earned his UFC contract with a 35-second knockout of Carlos Petruzzella on the Contender Series in August. A submission-first grappler who has added power on the feet; he takes this fight as the replacement for Gilbert Urbina.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy hands used behind his wrestling threat: on DWCS his first shot was stuffed, he switched to punching, backed Petruzzella to the fence and dropped him with a right hook before finishing with ground strikes (UFC.com). Also stopped Ty Gwerder with strikes in R3.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The base. Four submission wins (Cromartie R1, Morrison R2, Sobnosky R1, Benoit R1). Against Austin Clayton he took him down early and hunted a guillotine and inverted triangle in round one (per CFFC's recap).
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped. His one loss was a unanimous decision (29-28 x3) to fellow prospect Brandon Holmes at CFFC 134 in 2024. Clayton out-grappled him in rounds 3 and 4 of their title fight, so he can be held down by a strong wrestler.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A fast starter: 4 of his 6 stoppages came in round 1 (two of them inside two minutes), 1 in R2 and 1 late (Gwerder, 4:03 of R3). Over five rounds with Clayton, CFFC's recap says the first-round pace tired both men and he faded in the middle rounds before rallying to win the fifth on all three cards (48-47 x3, with a debatable round two).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Adapts in the moment (switched from a failed shot to strikes on DWCS) and found a gear late when the Clayton title was on the line. Has fought only under the CFFC banner before the Contender Series.

patterns: Fast starter: 4 of 6 finishes in round 1
Takedown or shot first, then submissions (guillotine, chokes) or ground strikes
Can still finish late (Gwerder, R3 TKO)
Slows after a high-output first round; won a five-round decision by rallying late
concerns: Stamina dip after a fast opening, seen in rounds 3-4 against Clayton
Out-wrestled for stretches by Clayton; lost a decision to Holmes
UFC debut; quick turnaround after the Aug. 25 DWCS fight
keys_to_beat: Survive the first round; his finishes come early
Wrestle with him and make him carry weight in rounds 2-3
Defend the first shot and avoid backing straight to the fence, where he lands his power

news.text: Won a UFC contract on Dana White's Contender Series with a 35-second knockout of Carlos Petruzzella.
Booked as the replacement for Gilbert Urbina against Julien Leblanc, his UFC debut (date per Wikipedia, citing MMA Junkie).
